title: Power-kernel fractional Sturm--Liouville operators: a graph realization and boundary-independent singular-value asymptotics
summary: For $\tfrac12 1/(2α)$, with weak-Schatten endpoint and Weyl asymptotics --- now for \emph{every} invertible boundary plane, not only the positive reference problem. As an application we obtain a mild-solution theorem for a Caputo-time diffusion equation in $C([0,T];L^2(0,1))$.
